cohort: Patients undergoing EXIT at the study center between January 2007 and December 2022, compared to a randomly selected sample of elective cesarean deliveries
finding: The EXIT procedure was not associated with a higher incidence of maternal complications compared to elective cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: While the EXIT procedure was associated with a higher rate of polyhydramnios, amnioreduction, and preterm delivery, it did not lead to a higher incidence of maternal complications compared to elective cesarean delivery.
